text: Aim [Lat. aestimare , to estimate]: Ger. Ziel ; Fr. fin , but ; Ital. scopo . A more remote or general project in voluntary action. Synonymous most nearly with PURPOSE (q.v.), and having a less exact meaning than the terms END and MOTIVE (cf. those terms). ( J.M.B. , G.F.S. )
